question: A, B, C, D, E and F live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on, till the topmost floor is numbered 6. B lives on an odd numbered floor but not 3. The sum of floors on which B and D live is 7. E lives immediately below F. C lives on the top floor. How many people live above E?
solution:

1) C lives on the top floor.

This means C is on **Floor 6**.
